nodes.question: Are both giraffes' silhouettes and major anatomical contours rendered as chalk-drawn lines?
nodes.criteria: Pass if both giraffes' silhouettes and major anatomical contours are visibly constructed with chalk-like sketch strokes, broken or powdery lines, or rubbed linear marks rather than merely retaining photographic edges. Inspect the heads, necks, torsos and legs of each giraffe. Chalk lines may be fine, dark, pale or layered; they need not be uniformly rough. Fail if substantial contours on either giraffe remain photographic boundaries with only blur or a grain overlay. Interior shading and spot construction are assessed separately and cannot substitute for drawn contours. Return unknown only if visual evidence is unavailable or genuinely insufficient; transport or schema failures are not visual failures.
nodes.binding: Compare the supplied SOURCE and EDITED images for 'Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk.' Inspect both giraffes' silhouettes and major anatomical contours, especially the heads, necks, torso boundaries and legs. Determine whether their edges have been reconstructed as chalk-drawn lines rather than merely softened. Background treatment cannot satisfy this condition.

nodes.question: Are both giraffes' markings and substantial interior modeling rendered through chalk drawing?
nodes.criteria: Pass if both giraffes' spot patterns and substantial interior shading are visibly re-expressed through chalk marks, layered strokes or form-describing rubbed shading. Inspect each giraffe separately. Detailed spots, dark shading, accurate anatomy and smooth blending are permitted when the visible rendering supports chalk construction. Fail if substantial interiors of either giraffe still depend on photographic surface detail or photographic modeling with only added grain, smearing or drawn outlines. Chalk contours alone do not satisfy this condition. Return unknown only if visual evidence is unavailable or genuinely insufficient; transport or schema failures are not visual failures.
nodes.binding: Compare the supplied SOURCE and EDITED images for 'Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk.' Inspect the spots and interior rendering of both giraffes' necks, torsos and legs, distinguishing chalk-built markings and shading from retained photographic modeling. Assess interiors independently of contour treatment and the surrounding scene.

nodes.question: Is the substantial surrounding scene rendered as a chalk drawing rather than merely softened or textured photographic scenery?
nodes.criteria: Pass if the substantial environment is re-expressed through chalk-drawn forms and shading. Inspect vegetation, hills, sky and ground separately, including substantial foreground structures. Chalk contours, broken or layered strokes, and rubbed shading may qualify; simplified forms and smooth sky passages are allowed. For broad rubbed passages, look for boundaries, layering or pigment variation that constructs the depicted terrain, vegetation, structures or ground planes, rather than relying solely on source-derived tonal fields. Reduced photographic detail, diagonal streaking, grain or smearing alone does not establish drawn construction. Fail if substantial environmental areas remain photographic modeling softened by blur or texture, even when nearby vegetation or the giraffes show convincing chalk treatment. Do not require every area to contain discrete strokes or regard retained composition as evidence of failure. Return unknown only when evidence is unavailable or genuinely insufficient; transport or schema failures are not visual failures.

program.checker_template: Evaluate ONE independent required condition against the SOURCE and EDITED images. No reference label, previous answers or optimization feedback is supplied.
